# bintables/make

> make: allocate a slice header {data, len, cap} and n zeroed elements.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/make.pkg) · translates [std/make](../std/make.md)

The slice value in rax is the address of the 24-byte header: the data
pointer at offset 0, the length at 8 and the capacity at 16.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{n}
test rax, rax
js __pk_panic_len
push rax
mov rdi, 24
call __pk_alloc
push rax
mov rax, [rsp+8]
imul rax, {t.elemsize}
mov rdi, rax
call __pk_alloc
pop rcx
pop rdx
mov [rcx], rax
mov [rcx+8], rdx
mov [rcx+16], rdx
mov rax, rcx
@alloc
```

Includes: [bintables/alloc](alloc.md)
